Length

length measurements for normalizing respiration rates

#Length measurements to normalize respiration rates
#all animals originate from 15 PSU cultures 
#then participate in control or low salinity respiration experiment

dat_length <- read.csv("Length_all.csv", sep = ";")

#calculate mean length per animal 
dat_length<- dat_length %>%
  group_by(Animal_ID, Month) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Mean_Length = mean(Length))

#remove unused columns and filter out unusable values (duplicates and bad qaulity)
dat_length_m <- dat_length %>%
  filter(Measurement_quality != "bad" |  is.na(Measurement_quality))

#keep only one row per animal  
dat_length_m <- dat_length_m %>%
  filter(File_name != "") 

dat_length_m$Station <- factor(dat_length_m$Station, 
                               levels = c("WH", "SK","BOK","KB03","SW08", "H21", 
                                          "BB23","GDY", "LL17", "IU7"))

stat <- glm(Mean_Length ~ Station * Treatment, data = dat_length_m)
print(Anova(stat, type = "II"))#no sig. effect of treatment on length (good)
## Analysis of Deviance Table (Type II tests)
## 
## Response: Mean_Length
##                   LR Chisq Df Pr(>Chisq)    
## Station            194.470  9     <2e-16 ***
## Treatment            2.829  1     0.0926 .  
## Station:Treatment   12.743  9     0.1746    
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
p <- ggplot(dat_length_m, aes(x = Station, y = Mean_Length, col = Station, fill = Station))+
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 0.7)+
  scale_color_manual(values = my_colors)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors)+
  facet_wrap(~Treatment)+
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2)+
  theme_light()+
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  ylab("Prosome length [µm]")+ xlab("Sampling location")

print(p)

#calculate mean length per station and treatment to standardise
dat_length_m <- dat_length_m %>%
  group_by(Station, Treatment, Month) %>%
  mutate(Mean_Group = mean(Mean_Length))

# calculate dry weight
# W = 13.4 x Length^3 (Kiørboe et al. 1985)

dat_length_m$Weight <- (((dat_length_m$Mean_Group)*0.001)^3)*13.4

#build table for conversion factors 
conversion_factors <- dat_length_m %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Tank_ID, Weight)%>%
  dplyr::distinct(Tank_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%  # Keep one row per Tank_ID
  dplyr::select(Tank_ID, Weight)  
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'Station', 'Treatment', 'Month'. You can
## override using the `.groups` argument.
## Adding missing grouping variables: `Station`, `Treatment`, `Month`
conversion_factors$Month <- as.numeric(conversion_factors$Month)

conversion_factors <- conversion_factors %>%
  mutate(Group = paste(Station, Treatment, Month, sep = "_"))

Respiration

#respiration measured in uL O2 per hour
resp_uL <- read.csv("Respiration.csv", sep = ";")
resp_uL$O2_final <- resp_uL$Oxygen/resp_uL$Individuals
resp_uL$Salinity <- as.factor(resp_uL$Salinity)
resp_uL$Station <- factor(resp_uL$Station, 
                          levels = c("WH", "SK","BOK", "KB03","SW08", "H21", 
                                     "BB23","GDY", "LL17", "IU7"))
resp_uL <- resp_uL %>%
  mutate(Group = paste(Station, Salinity, Month, sep = "_"))

#adjust for body weight (based on length measurements)
resp_uL <- resp_uL %>%
  left_join(conversion_factors, by = c("Group", "Station", "Month"))%>%
  mutate(Oxygen_adjusted = O2_final/Weight)

#plot oxygen consumption adjusted for body size
ggplot(resp_uL, aes(x = factor(Station), y = Oxygen_adjusted, fill = factor(Station))) +
  theme_light()+
  facet_wrap(~Salinity, labeller = labeller(Salinity = c("5" = "5 PSU", "15" = "15 PSU")))+
  theme(strip.background =element_rect(fill="white"))+
  theme(strip.text = element_text(colour = 'black', size = 12))+
  labs(x = "Station", y = expression(mu*L~O[2]~h^{-1}~mu*g^{-1}~dry~weight)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA)+
  geom_point(aes(color = factor(Station)), position = position_jitter(width = 0.15), size = 2)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors, guide = "none") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = my_colors, name = "Population")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size = 9))

#ggsave("Supplemental_Respiration.pdf", dpi = 300, width = 18.2, height = 15, units = "cm")
#stats for respiration
stat <- lm(Oxygen_adjusted ~ Salinity*Station, data = resp_uL)

#check for normal distribution
hist(resid(stat))

shapiro.test(resid(stat))#non-normal distribution
## 
##  Shapiro-Wilk normality test
## 
## data:  resid(stat)
## W = 0.95779, p-value = 4.284e-05
# --> log transform
resp_uL$log_Oxygen <- log(resp_uL$Oxygen_adjusted)#log transform

#run test again
stat <- lm(log_Oxygen ~ Salinity*Station, data = resp_uL)

hist(resid(stat))

shapiro.test(resid(stat))#meets normality assumptions now
## 
##  Shapiro-Wilk normality test
## 
## data:  resid(stat)
## W = 0.9911, p-value = 0.3548
#summary(stat)
Anova(stat, type = "II") #interaction not significant --> type II more powerful
## Anova Table (Type II tests)
## 
## Response: log_Oxygen
##                   Sum Sq  Df F value    Pr(>F)    
## Salinity          1.1069   1  8.4414  0.004208 ** 
## Station          10.5104   9  8.9062 9.473e-11 ***
## Salinity:Station  2.0806   9  1.7630  0.079528 .  
## Residuals        20.1930 154                      
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
#station significant, salinity significant, interaction only marginal

#check residuals
par(mfrow = c(2,2))
plot(stat)

par(mfrow = c(1,1))

emm <- emmeans(stat, ~ Salinity)
## NOTE: Results may be misleading due to involvement in interactions
plot(emm)#lower means at low salinity

emm <- emmeans(stat, ~ Station | Salinity)
cld(emm, adjust = "tukey",
    Letters = letters,
    alpha = 0.05)
## Note: adjust = "tukey" was changed to "sidak"
## because "tukey" is only appropriate for one set of pairwise comparisons

Acute mortality

mort <- read.csv("Mortality.csv", sep = ";")

mort$Time_factor <- as.factor(mort$Time)
mort$Treatment_factor <- as.factor(mort$Treatment_sal)
mort$Station <- factor(mort$Station, 
                              levels = c("WH", "SK","BOK","KB03", "SW08", "H21", "BB23","GDY", "LL17", "IU7"))

#random effect/repeated measures
mort$log_sal <- log10(mort$Treatment_sal)
mort$GroupID <- mort$GroupID <- paste(mort$Station, mort$Treatment_sal, mort$Replicate, sep = "_")

m_mort_random0 <- glmer(
  Active ~ log_sal*Station*Time_factor + (1|GroupID),
  family = binomial,
  data = mort,
  control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5)))
## Warning in checkConv(attr(opt, "derivs"), opt$par, ctrl = control$checkConv, :
## unable to evaluate scaled gradient
## Warning in checkConv(attr(opt, "derivs"), opt$par, ctrl = control$checkConv, :
## Model failed to converge: degenerate Hessian with 2 negative eigenvalues
m_mort_random <- glmer(
  Active ~ log_sal+ Station + Time_factor + log_sal:Station + log_sal:Time_factor + Station:Time_factor + (1|GroupID),
  family = binomial,
  data = mort,
  control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5)))

anova(m_mort_random0, m_mort_random)#drop 3-way, model without has lower BIC and AIC
## Data: mort
## Models:
## m_mort_random: Active ~ log_sal + Station + Time_factor + log_sal:Station + log_sal:Time_factor + Station:Time_factor + (1 | GroupID)
## m_mort_random0: Active ~ log_sal * Station * Time_factor + (1 | GroupID)
##                npar    AIC    BIC  logLik deviance  Chisq Df Pr(>Chisq)
## m_mort_random    54 1930.9 2263.7 -911.46   1822.9                     
## m_mort_random0   81 1951.5 2450.6 -894.75   1789.5 33.431 27     0.1832
#test model residuals
residualData <- tibble(resid = resid(m_mort_random, type = "response"),
                       fitted = fitted(m_mort_random))

ggplot(residualData, aes(x = fitted, y = resid)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3)

binnedplot(x = residualData$fitted,
           y = residualData$resid)

#test random effect
m_mort_nr <- glm(
  Active ~ log_sal+ Station + Time_factor + log_sal:Station + log_sal:Time_factor + Station:Time_factor,
  family = binomial,
  data = mort)

anova(m_mort_random, m_mort_nr)#significant --> random effect matters

#survival probability per time point
emm_dose <- emmeans(m_mort_random, ~ log_sal * Station | Time_factor,
                    at = list(log_sal = log10(c(0.1, 2, 3, 5, 15))))

emm_dose_df <- as.data.frame(emm_dose)
emm_dose_df$prob <- plogis(emm_dose_df$emmean)
emm_dose_df$lower <- plogis(emm_dose_df$asymp.LCL)
emm_dose_df$upper <- plogis(emm_dose_df$asymp.UCL)
emm_dose_df$Treatment_sal <- 10^(emm_dose_df$log_sal)

p <- ggplot(emm_dose_df, aes(x = Treatment_sal, y = prob, color = Station)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.05) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ Time_factor) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = my_colors) +
  ylab("Predicted survival probability") +
  xlab("Salinity [PSU]") +
  theme_light() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

plot(p)

## NOTE: If two or more means share the same grouping symbol,

##       But we also did not show them to be the same.
#get slope and intercept from predicted survival curves to estimate LS50 and LS5
slope_emm <- emtrends(
  m_mort_random,
  ~ Station * Time_factor,
  var = "log_sal"
)

int_emm <- emmeans(
  m_mort_random,
  ~ Station * Time_factor,
  at = list(log_sal = 0)
)

slope_df <- as.data.frame(slope_emm)
int_df   <- as.data.frame(int_emm)

ls50_df <- merge(slope_df, int_df,
                 by = c("Station","Time_factor"))

#set y-intercept (50% mortality and 5% mortality)
c50 <- logit(0.5)
c5 <- logit(0.95)

ls50_df$logLS50 <- (c50 - ls50_df$emmean) / ls50_df$log_sal.trend
ls50_df$LS50 <- 10^(ls50_df$logLS50)

ls50_df$logLS5 <- (c5 - ls50_df$emmean) / ls50_df$log_sal.trend
ls50_df$LS5    <- 10^ls50_df$logLS5

#SE for LS5
ls50_df$SE_logLS5 <- sqrt(
  (ls50_df$SE.y / ls50_df$log_sal.trend)^2 +
    (ls50_df$emmean * ls50_df$SE.x / ls50_df$log_sal.trend^2)^2
)

ls50_df$SE_LS5 <- ls50_df$LS5 * log(10) * ls50_df$SE_logLS5

ls50_df$lower5 <- 10^(ls50_df$logLS5 - 1.96*ls50_df$SE_logLS5)
ls50_df$upper5 <- 10^(ls50_df$logLS5 + 1.96*ls50_df$SE_logLS5)


#SE for LS50
ls50_df$SE_logLS50 <- sqrt(
  (ls50_df$SE.y / ls50_df$log_sal.trend)^2 +
    (ls50_df$emmean * ls50_df$SE.x / ls50_df$log_sal.trend^2)^2
)

ls50_df$SE_LS50 <- ls50_df$LS50 * log(10) * ls50_df$SE_logLS50

ls50_df$lower50 <- 10^(ls50_df$logLS50 - 1.96*ls50_df$SE_logLS50)
ls50_df$upper50 <- 10^(ls50_df$logLS50 + 1.96*ls50_df$SE_logLS50)

#summarise mean values
summary_ls <- ls50_df %>% 
  group_by(Time_factor, Station)%>%
  summarise(MeanLS50 = mean(LS50),
            MeanLS5 = mean(LS5))
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'Time_factor'. You can override using the
## `.groups` argument.
ggplot(ls50_df, aes(x = Station, y = LS50, color = Station))+
  geom_point(size = 4)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower50, ymax = upper50), width = 0.2) +
  theme_light()+
  facet_wrap(~Time_factor, scales = "free_y")+
  scale_color_manual(values = my_colors)

#plot model predictions
newdat <- expand.grid(
  log_sal = seq(min(mort$log_sal),
                max(mort$log_sal),
                length = 200),
  Station = levels(mort$Station),
  Time_factor = levels(mort$Time_factor)
)

# convert back to salinity for plotting
newdat$Treatment_sal <- 10^(newdat$log_sal)


newdat$pred <- predict(
  m_mort_random,
  newdata = newdat,
  type = "response",
  re.form = NA #removes random effect
)

ggplot(mort, aes(x = Treatment_sal, y = Active)) +
  theme_light(base_size = 12) +
  
  facet_wrap(~Time_factor,
             labeller = labeller(Time_factor =
                                   c("2" = "after 2 h",
                                     "24" = "after 24 h",
                                     "48" = "after 48 h",
                                     "72" = "after 72 h"))) +
  
  geom_point(aes(fill = Station), size = 2,shape = 21, alpha = 0.2,
             position = position_dodge(0.15))+
  
  geom_line(data = newdat,
            aes(x = Treatment_sal,
                y = pred,
                color = Station),
            linewidth = 1) +
  
  theme(strip.background =element_rect(fill="white"))+
  theme(strip.text = element_text(colour = 'black'))+
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = my_colors) +
  
  scale_x_log10() +
  xlab("Salinity [PSU]") +
  ylab("Predicted proportion active") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

#subset to plot only 24 and 2
mort_sub <- subset(mort, Time <= 24)
mort_sub$Time_factor <- droplevels(mort_sub$Time_factor)

newdat_sub <- subset(newdat, Time_factor %in% c("2", "24"))
newdat_sub$Time_factor <- factor(newdat_sub$Time_factor, levels = c("2", "24"))


ggplot(mort_sub, aes(x = Treatment_sal, y = Active)) +
  theme_light(base_size = 12) +
  
  facet_wrap(~Time_factor,
             labeller = labeller(Time_factor =
                                   c("2" = "after 2 h",
                                     "24" = "after 24 h"))) +
  
  geom_point(aes(fill = Station), size = 2,shape = 21, alpha = 0.2,
             position = position_dodge(0.15))+
  
  geom_line(data = newdat_sub,
aes(x = Treatment_sal,
    y = pred,
    color = Station),
linewidth = 1) +
  
  theme(strip.background =element_rect(fill="white"))+
  theme(strip.text = element_text(colour = 'black'))+
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = my_colors) +
  
  scale_x_log10() +
  xlab("Salinity [PSU]") +

  theme(legend.position = "none")
